mechanics.claim: Casting any basic ability puts Sona's other basic abilities on a brief shared cooldown.
mechanics.quote: her other basic abilities incur a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} global cooldown

mechanics.claim: The empowered Power Chord attack resets Sona's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sona's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack applies normal on-hit effects and can critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The triggering attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup.
The empowered attack does not trigger or apply against wards and jungle plants (not relevant against a champion dummy).
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants]].

mechanics.claim: Accelerando stacks are gained by hitting an enemy champion with Hymn of Valor or sufficiently shielding/healing with Aria of Perseverance, up to 120 stacks.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'', stacking up to 120 times

mechanics.claim: Only one Melody aura (self/ally empowerment) can be active at a time.
mechanics.quote: Only one aura can be active at a time.

mechanics.claim: The last basic ability cast determines Power Chord's bonus effect (Staccato, Diminuendo, or Tempo).
mechanics.quote: apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast
